name: perf-integration-pekko
description: Released Scala 2.13.18 (Maven Central) against the scala2-perf-integration branch (upstream/2.13.x + retronym's open perf PRs, built as released: setupPublishCore, optimizer on), both published jars, compiling pekko-actor (203 Scala + 28 Java files, exported from the zinc integration campaigns) in memory.

Like for like with the Scala 3 campaign: `pekko-actor-plain` compiles the sources with `-encoding UTF-8 -feature -unchecked -deprecation -language:higherKinds -release 17`, the option set pekko's Scala 3 build uses, not pekko's Scala 2 `-opt:l:inline` and `-Xlint`/`-Ywarn-unused` (those cells, `pekko-actor`, are kept from the first rounds but are not comparable).
Directional, not absolute: one fork per cell, 3 rounds, JDK 21.

variantDescriptions.main: scala2-perf-integration, setupPublishBuild publishLocal (see PERF-INTEGRATION.md on the branch)
